name: Episode Ten
title: The Waiting Room
follows: Episode Nine, No Harm Done: Sergio sits in the dark wondering what a nephew who talks to a doctor might say.
arc: Sergio has Nico's Thursdays watched. Nico keeps Dr. Vos's door out of it with a back doctor's card, a ruined roll of film and a careful lunch, and keeps his appointment. Sergio decides to let him think it worked.

missions.title: Parked Outside
missions.mechanic: stake-out (sit still 0:20 out of Joey's 16 m), long-lens photo, tail the grey sedan
objectives: Stake-out. Sit tight and keep away from the grey sedan: don't let him see you. 0:20
Photograph the man by the grey sedan: click, or press E.
Follow the grey sedan, and don't lose it. Not too close.
missions.story: Sergio's doubt from the end of Episode Nine: his driver is outside the office. Where Joey reports to is who sent him.
missions.fallbacks: seen 3 times: the stake-out passes; tail lost twice: it skips to the luncheonette

missions.title: Fifty Minutes
missions.mechanic: therapy with a #menu choice (tell her / say nothing), saved as choices.vos
objectives: Thursday. Drive to Dr. Vos's office.
missions.story: He cannot keep the watcher away from her door, so the question is whether he tells her. The answer decides where the card in mission 62 comes from.

missions.title: The Card
missions.mechanic: stealth delivery past a pacing watcher (red blip, r 7); the 'say nothing' path first picks up the card from Morty at Low Tide Records
objectives: Drive to Low Tide Records. Morty has a back man's card. (quiet path only)
Drive to the luncheonette. Park up the street, past the grey sedan.
Slip the card into Joey's car without being seen. Keep away from Joey: he is red on the radar.
missions.story: Joey has to report something; better that he finds a dull reason himself, on his own car seat.
missions.fallbacks: caught twice: Joey goes in to pay and the step has no watcher

missions.title: Camera Shy
missions.mechanic: foot chase (flee AI, yellow arrow), fists only, take the film
objectives: Chase down the man with the camera: follow the yellow arrow.
missions.story: A back is not enough for Sergio; he pays a wedding photographer for a picture of the door.
missions.fallbacks: 75 s of chasing without a hit: he trips

missions.title: Lunch
missions.mechanic: three #menu choices (Calm / Respect / Deal first), then shake a tail
objectives: Drive to the luncheonette. Uncle Sergio is buying.
Lose the grey sedan before you go anywhere near Dr. Vos's.
missions.story: Sergio finally asks to his face, and sends Joey after him anyway.

missions.title: Four O'Clock
objectives: Drive to Dr. Vos's office. She starts at four, with you or without you. m:ss
missions.story: He keeps the appointment that started it all; Sergio decides to let him think it worked.
missions.fallbacks: late twice: she waited, and the mission goes on
